idea-plugin.name: Play Declaration Gap Lint
idea-plugin.description:
15 checks that name every Play Console declaration your manifest opens

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Play Declaration Gap Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/play-declaration-gap-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/play-declaration-gap-lint

action.text: Play Declaration Gap Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Play Declaration Gap Lint on the file in the editor
